places.name: West Lake (Xi Hu)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, West Lake is a serene and picturesque freshwater lake surrounded by temples, pagodas, and gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or during sunset.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the lake’s surroundings.

places.name: Leifeng Pagoda
places.ai_summary: A historic pagoda offering panoramic views of West Lake and the surrounding area, steeped in Chinese folklore.

opening_hours.notes: Evenings are ideal for sunset views.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for the best views of West Lake.
places.address: 15 Nanshan Rd, Xihu District, Hangzhou, China

places.name: Lingyin Temple
places.ai_summary: One of the largest and most famous Buddhist temples in China, surrounded by lush forests and ancient grottoes.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available for a deeper understanding of the temple’s history.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a hike to Feilai Peak nearby.
places.address: 1 Fayun Ln, Xihu District, Hangzhou, China

places.name: Broken Bridge
places.ai_summary: A picturesque bridge with a broken arch, offering a unique view of the lake and surrounding hills, especially beautiful in the snow.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Visit in winter to see the snow-covered bridge.

places.name: Three Pools Mirroring the Moon
places.ai_summary: A scenic spot on West Lake featuring three small islands with ancient pagodas, best viewed from the lake.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from a boat on the lake.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour for the best experience.
places.address: Three Pools Mirroring the Moon, Hangzhou, China

places.name: Hefang Street
places.ai_summary: A bustling pedestrian street with a mix of traditional and modern shops, restaurants, and teahouses, reflecting the local culture.

opening_hours.notes: Evenings are lively with street performances.

places.place_tip: Try local snacks and visit traditional medicine shops.

places.name: Xixi National Wetland Park
places.ai_summary: A unique urban wetland park with rich biodiversity, featuring lakes, marshland, and a network of walking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning for bird watching.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking on the trails.

places.name: China National Tea Museum
places.ai_summary: The only national tea museum in China, showcasing the history and culture of tea with beautiful tea gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Check for seasonal tea picking experiences.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the tea tasting sessions.
places.address: China National Tea Museum, Hangzhou, China

places.name: Longjing Tea Fields
places.ai_summary: Famous for its high-quality green tea, these terraces offer a scenic landscape and a glimpse into the tea production process.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for tea picking experiences.

places.place_tip: Visit a tea house for a tasting session.

places.name: Hu Xueyan’s Former Residence
places.ai_summary: The former residence of a famous Chinese businessman, showcasing traditional architecture and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available to explore the residence.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy the traditional tea service.
places.address: Hu Xueyan’s Former Residence, Hangzhou, China

places.name: Qiantang River Bridge
places.ai_summary: A major bridge in Hangzhou, offering great views of the Qiantang River and the city, especially at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for sunset views.

places.place_tip: Walk or cycle across the bridge for the best experience.

places.name: Hangzhou Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: A large and diverse botanical garden featuring a wide variety of plants, flowers, and themed gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in spring for the blooming flowers.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the various plant species.

places.name: Prince Bay Park
places.ai_summary: A scenic park by the West Lake, featuring beautiful gardens, pavilions, and a peaceful atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for a peaceful walk or a picnic.

places.place_tip: Visit the flower garden and the pavilion by the lake.

places.name: Grand Canal Hangzhou
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this ancient canal is famous for its historical significance and scenic views.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by boat.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to appreciate the canal’s beauty.

places.name: Song Dynasty Town Theme Park
places.ai_summary: A cultural theme park that recreates the Song Dynasty era with traditional architecture, performances, and activities.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performance times.

places.place_tip: Participate in the interactive activities for a fun experience.

attribution.title: 1-10Villa at 6, Jiurenhecun
attribution.author: Laohangzhou
attribution.description:
Traditional villa and portal — at 6, Jiurenhecun, Hangzhou (formerly transliterated as Hangchow).
A protected Hang Zhou Historic House — in the city of Hangzhou, in Eastern China.
Constructed between 1911 and 1949, it is two-story brick-stone structured villa with slope-roof, the typical villa style at that time.

places.name: Feilai Peak
places.ai_summary: A famous peak in Hangzhou with a rich history and cultural significance, offering stunning views of the West Lake.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with Lingyin Temple.

places.name: Six Harmonies Pagoda
places.ai_summary: An ancient pagoda with a rich history, offering panoramic views of the Qiantang River and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Evenings are ideal for sunset views.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for the best views of the Qiantang River.

places.name: Guo’s Villa
places.ai_summary: A historic villa with beautiful gardens and a rich collection of Chinese art and antiques.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available to explore the villa.

places.place_tip: Explore the art collection and the beautiful gardens.

places.name: Yue Fei Temple
places.ai_summary: A temple dedicated to the famous Chinese general Yue Fei, featuring traditional architecture and serene gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Evenings are ideal for a peaceful visit.

places.place_tip: Explore the temple complex and the surrounding gardens.

places.name: Baochu Pagoda
places.ai_summary: A historic pagoda with beautiful views of the West Lake, surrounded by lush greenery.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for a panoramic view of West Lake.
